RAW SENSOR DATA AVAILABLE ON REQUEST
====================================

The raw sensor time series (sensor_data.csv) of the following deployment
projects are not part of the public repository and are made available upon
special request to the authors or curators of this dataset
(Thomas Maier, thomas.maier@fau.de). Derived event tables and tree
attributes for these trees are included.

The photographs of the Potsdam trees (tree-appraisal campaigns and
soil-profile pictures) are restricted in the same way — see
GISData/CityPotsdam/PICTURES_ON_REQUEST.txt. Pictures of the monitored
trees in multiple seasons are available on request for all deployments.
